subject: math

objective.text: Solve word problems about different ways to make change from 1 dollar.

explanations.title: 1 dollar is 100 cents
explanations.text: A dollar is the same as 100 cents. You can write 100 cents as $1 in a number sentence. So 24 cents and a missing amount can make $1.

explanations.title: Find the change
explanations.text: Change is the money you get back. Take the cost away from 1 dollar. Or count on from the cost up to 1 dollar. Both ways find the change.

explanations.title: Find the cost from the change
explanations.text: Sometimes you know the change. Find the value of the change coins. The cost and the change are the two parts of 1 dollar. Take the change from 1 dollar to find the cost.

explanations.title: Take one from both numbers
explanations.text: Take 1 away from both numbers to make a problem that is easier. 100 minus 57 has the same answer as 99 minus 56. You do not need to rename.

explanations.title: Check your answer
explanations.text: Reread the problem. Add the cost and the change. They should make 100 cents, or 1 dollar. If they do not, check again.

explanations.title: Dollars and cents
explanations.text: A dollar is made of 100 cents. This is like a hundred made of ten tens. We can trade 1 dollar for 100 cents.

examples.title: Shay buys a balloon
examples.text: The balloon costs 57 cents. Shay hands over 1 dollar. 57 cents plus 43 cents equals 100 cents. Shay gets 43 cents in change.

examples.title: Jamie's baseball card
examples.text: Jamie gets 2 dimes, 1 quarter and 1 penny in change. That is 46 cents. 100 minus 46 equals 54. The card cost 54 cents.

examples.title: Penelope's toy whistle
examples.text: Penelope has 15 pennies, 2 nickels, 2 dimes and 1 quarter. That is 70 cents. The whistle costs 1 dollar. She needs 30 more cents.
